appPath.description: Directory of the Laravel application in the image (its WORKDIR): `/app` for FrankenPHP images, usually `/var/www/html` for the official PHP-FPM images.

enabled.description: Enable the web HorizontalPodAutoscaler (not with SQLite or a ReadWriteOnce volume).

command.description: Command of the web container (empty: the image entrypoint), e.g. `["php", "artisan", "octane:frankenphp", "--port=8000"]`.

emptyDirSizeLimit.description: Size limit of the emptyDir volumes (`/tmp`, writable paths, public files copy, Caddy state). Empty: no limit.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts of every Laravel container.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes of every Laravel pod.

rules.description: Routing rules (each one is sent to the Service).

digest.description: Image digest (`sha256:...`). When set, it takes precedence over the tag.

repository.description: Application image repository, fully qualified (e.g. `registry.example.com/acme/shop`). Required.

tag.description: Application image tag. Required unless `digest` is set (the chart appVersion is the Laravel version, not a tag of your image).

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling images from a private registry.

initContainers.description: Extra init containers of the web pods (run after the chart ones).

access_key_id.description: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, stored in the chart secret.

enabled.description: Render the AWS_* variables (S3 filesystem disk).

endpoint.description: AWS_ENDPOINT (S3 compatible storage: MinIO, Garage, Ceph RGW...).

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the AWS settings (each `secretKeys` entry overrides the plain value, `""` keeps it).

secret_access_key.description: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, stored in the chart secret.

connection.description: DB_CONNECTION: `sqlite` (single web replica, file on the persistent volume), `pgsql`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `sqlsrv`.

database.description: DB_DATABASE: database name, or the SQLite file path relative to `appPath` or absolute (empty: `storage/database/database.sqlite`). The SQLite file needs its own directory: it is mounted from the persistent volume.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the connection settings. Each `secretKeys` entry read from it overrides the plain value; set an entry to `""` to keep the plain value (e.g. a secret holding only the password).

password.description: DB_PASSWORD, stored in the chart secret (required unless SQLite or `existingSecret`).

port.description: DB_PORT (empty: the default port of the connection).

debug.description: APP_DEBUG. Never enable it in production.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables of every Laravel container (rendered last: they override the chart variables).

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources of every Laravel container.

filesystem_disk.description: FILESYSTEM_DISK. Use `s3` (see `aws`) to scale out without a ReadWriteMany volume.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding APP_KEY (takes precedence over `value`).

value.description: APP_KEY (`base64:...`). Leave empty to generate one, kept across upgrades. Set it explicitly, or use `existingSecret`, with GitOps tools that render templates offline.

channel.description: LOG_CHANNEL. `stderr` sends the logs to `kubectl logs`; file channels write to the ephemeral `storage/logs`.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the mail settings (each `secretKeys` entry overrides the plain value, `""` keeps it).

password.description: MAIL_PASSWORD, stored in the chart secret.

driver.description: APP_MAINTENANCE_DRIVER. Use `cache` with a shared store (database, redis) so `php artisan down` reaches every pod.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the Redis settings (each `secretKeys` entry overrides the plain value, `""` keeps it).

password.description: REDIS_PASSWORD, stored in the chart secret.

secretEnv.description: Secret environment variables (`NAME: value`), stored in the chart secret and injected with secretKeyRef.

driver.description: SESSION_DRIVER. Use a shared store (database, redis) with several web replicas.

url.description: APP_URL (empty: derived from the first Ingress host, else Laravel's default).

enabled.description: Render VITE_APP_NAME (only useful to server-side code: Vite variables are compiled at build time).

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle hooks of the web container (the sleep lets endpoints drain before the server stops).

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe of the HTTP container (FrankenPHP, or nginx with `fpm`). `/up` is the health route of Laravel 11+.

allowedFrom.description: Peers allowed to reach the web pods (e.g. the ingress controller namespace). Empty: any source. Pods of the release are always allowed.

enabled.description: Restrict egress of every pod to DNS, the release pods and `rules`.

rules.description: Allowed egress rules (database, Redis, SMTP, S3, external APIs...).

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies: the web pods only accept HTTP, the other pods accept nothing.

accessModes.description: Access modes. With `ReadWriteOnce` the web Deployment runs a single replica (`Recreate`) and the queue/scheduler pods are scheduled on its node; `ReadWriteMany` lifts both limits.

enabled.description: Store `paths` (and the SQLite database) on a PersistentVolumeClaim shared by the web, queue and scheduler pods.

paths.description: Directories stored on the volume, relative to `appPath` or absolute (each one in its own sub-directory of the volume).

storageClass.description: Storage class (empty uses the cluster default).

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget for the web pods (useful with 2+ replicas).

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable pods (used instead of minAvailable when set).

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. 33 is `www-data` in the Debian based PHP images (82 in the Alpine ones): files only need to be readable by this user, writable paths are volumes.

prepareResources.description: Resources of the `prepare` init container (seeds the writable paths, copies the public files for nginx).

publicPath.description: Public directory served over HTTP, relative to `appPath` or absolute (empty: `<appPath>/public`). With the nginx sidecar it is copied from the image and served at the same path.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe of the HTTP container.

replicaCount.description: Number of web replicas. Must stay at 1 with SQLite or a ReadWriteOnce persistent volume.

resources.description: Resources of the web container (FrankenPHP or PHP-FPM).

securityContext.description: Security context of the Laravel containers.

seedWritablePaths.description: Copy what the image ships in each writable path before Laravel starts (keeps the `bootstrap/cache/*.php` files and the directory skeleton built into the image). Needs `/bin/sh` and `cp` in the image.

port.description: Service port (mapped to the HTTP port of the web pods).

automount.description: Mount the service account token. Laravel does not talk to the Kubernetes API.

sidecars.description: Extra containers of the web pods.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe of the HTTP container.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period of the web pods.

image.description: Image used by `helm test` (needs `wget`; defaults to the nginx image).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints of the web pods.

updateStrategy.description: Web Deployment update strategy. The chart forces `Recreate` with a ReadWriteOnce persistent volume.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Maximum duration of the migration Job, in seconds (also raise `helm --timeout`).

enabled.description: Run the database migrations: a pre-install/pre-upgrade Job, or with SQLite an init container of the web pod.

config.description: Replace the default `server { }` block (it must listen on `port`, use `root` = the public path and pass PHP to `127.0.0.1:<fpm port>`).

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts of the nginx container.

digest.description: Image digest (takes precedence over the tag).

ipv6.description: Also listen on IPv6 (dual-stack clusters). nginx fails to start in pods without IPv6.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle hooks of the nginx container (the sleep lets endpoints drain before nginx stops).

securityContext.description: Security context of the nginx container.

workerProcesses.description: nginx worker processes (`auto` starts one per node CPU).

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe of the queue workers.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a worker gets to finish its current job on shutdown (keep it above the job timeout).

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe of the PHP-FPM container (the HTTP probes run on the nginx sidecar).

port.description: Port PHP-FPM listens on (FastCGI). The nginx sidecar reaches it on 127.0.0.1.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe of the PHP-FPM container.

keepNetBindService.description: Keep NET_BIND_SERVICE in the bounding set: the official FrankenPHP binary carries it as a file capability and cannot be executed without it. Set false if your image strips it (`setcap -r /usr/local/bin/frankenphp`).

serverName.description: SERVER_NAME given to the stock FrankenPHP Caddyfile (empty: `:<port>`, plain HTTP on that port).

type.description: How the web pods serve HTTP: `frankenphp` (the image serves HTTP itself) or `fpm` (PHP-FPM + nginx sidecar).

backoffLimit.description: Retries of a failed run (a retry would run in a later minute).

concurrencyPolicy.description: CronJob concurrency policy. `Forbid` skips a minute while the previous run is still going (use `runInBackground()` for long tasks).

mode.description: `cronjob`: a CronJob runs `schedule:run` every minute. `deployment`: one long-running pod runs `schedule:work` (no pod per minute).

startingDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds after its schedule a missed run may still start.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds a finished Job is kept.

writablePaths.description: Directories Laravel writes to, relative to `appPath` or absolute. They are emptyDir volumes so the root filesystem can stay read-only; a path also listed in `persistence.paths` lives on the persistent volume instead.
